scope: Serialized native entity and template definitions; not a reconstruction of gameplay execution.

decodingRules.guidEncoding: original serialized 20 bytes, retained without UUID rewriting
decodingRules.propertyContainer: u16 serializer version + i32 enum value
decodingRules.array: u8 uninterpreted prefix + i32 count + elements
decodingRules.classBoundaries: original object size; whole payload consumption required for decoded status
decodingRules.inventory: u16 stack-list version; i32 count; subclass stack records; u16 slot-list version; i32 slot count; subclass slot records or exact 010000 empty markers; five cached eCEntityProxy records
decodingRules.playerAttributes: class version > 4: i32 count; repeated string-table u16 key and subclass gCAttribute record
decodingRules.offsets: byte offsets in original source when read_gameplay_file/read_template_file is used; nested offsets also carry position in enclosing raw tail/property
decodingRules.itemTail: 23-byte ITEM_STATS writer constant preserved; i32 slot; u8 visible; u8 arrayprefix; i32 count; repeated u16 script version + five string entries; u8 scriptExecuted. Script rows are data, not executed.
decodingRules.booleanContainer: u16 serializer version plus one strict bool byte; type/length inference explicitly attached to value.

limitations: World and template values are serialized records before native loading, callbacks, script initialization, treasure generation, difficulty scaling and quest-controlled activation.
A gCInventorySlot template reference identifies a definition; it does not prove a current inventory stack exists.
Empty cached treasure-set proxies do not mean a treasure set produces no items.
The data normalizer preserves all opaque property/tail bytes and unsupported reasons.
Enum symbols come from pinned g3dit declarations; native numeric values remain authoritative even when no symbol is known.
Unresolved reference GUIDs remain unresolved; helper item/template reference headers keep separate identities.
Native pseudocode is decompiler output with unknown fields and signatures; it is evidence, not buildable source.

nativeEvidence.supports: Controlled/physics movement dispatch; animation update; floor handling. Requires replacement collision/animation systems.
Interaction candidate collection and source range/pickability/equipment guards.
Camera-ray and native physics hit-based focus; field offsets unresolved.
Transfer/equipment/quest-notification behavior; apparent parameter convention unresolved.
World version/config, SysDyn and sector import ordering; no browser loader equivalence asserted.
Native version-specific inventory reader identity; body review recorded separately.
Two container reader thunks then five cached proxy Read calls; native gCInventory_PS::Read chooses separate readers for versions3..9.
Map count then name and accessor-class records; native calls CreateAttributes for missing/broken entries. Decoder never invokes it.
Native allowed header version39..62; filename serialized from57; versioned timestamp/scaling/flags.
Before header42 direct accessor subclass records; from42 version/preSize/preType/accessor/DEADC0DE; template references and post-read callbacks are not executed.
Versioned legacy entity headers/property sets. Native decompiler has unresolved substituted parameter references; entire source-boundary audit is required.
Raw legacy node entity count/creator flags/dependency tree.
Version30 entity-only, other versions creator proxy and conditional spatial boxes from35.
Dynamic version and legacy boolean below83, creator flag/GUID then entity header.
Context versioned bool/floats/box before entitycount, then dependencies.
Calls AssureItems then sets hotkey; final bool true calls SetLearned(true), false does not clear Learned. Does not equip stack.
